An unguarded small smile breaks as she sees the fresh coral. Soft curtain sway and ocean light flicker at the open balcony. Ends ready for her pocketing the tube and standing.

soft morning ocean waves through open balcony door, gentle curtain rustle, quiet room tone. soft lipstick tube click, lips press together lightly.

No BGM, no music. Generate only dialogue, environmental sounds, and action sounds. Single continuous shot, no cuts. Avoid jitter and bent limbs.
